subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this PR advance the per-agent SQLite schema from version 10 to 11 for session-owned ACP parent-stream diagnostics?
rationale: Repository policy prohibits autonomous SQLite schema-version bumps, and choosing a new table versus an existing compatible storage owner requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve schema v11 after proof
options.body: Keep the session-owned table, preserve external diagnostic access, and approve the bump after fresh-install and upgrade evidence passes.

options.title: Avoid a schema bump
options.body: Rework ACP diagnostics onto an existing compatible canonical table or defer that surface from this PR.

recommendation.title: Approve schema v11 after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the session-owned table, preserve external diagnostic access, and approve the bump after fresh-install and upgrade evidence passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite work established the affected per-agent database and migration boundary.
